summary: The Kubernetes Secret Provider writes a secret (Name, NameSpace) to MountPath on the device, but only from the cluster Edge Manager runs on; grant the flightctl-worker service account get/list on secrets in that namespace with a ClusterRole and ClusterRoleBinding.
questions: How do I deliver a Kubernetes secret to an edge device?
Can Edge Manager read secrets from another cluster?
What RBAC does flightctl-worker need for secrets?
What parameters does the Kubernetes Secret Provider take?
